description: Category theory + type theory decomposed. Limits + colimits, products + coproducts, exponential objects, monoidal categories, topos theory, sheaves, type theory variants (System F, dependent types, HoTT), proof assistants (Coq, Lean, Agda).

sub_mechanisms.name: products_coproducts
sub_mechanisms.definition: Product A × B: pairs. Coproduct A + B: disjoint union. Universal properties.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of categorical constructions. Programming: tuples + sum types.

sub_mechanisms.name: limits_colimits
sub_mechanisms.definition: Limits: universal cones to diagram (intersections, products, equalizers). Colimits dual.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Subsume many constructions. Pullbacks, pushouts, inverse + direct limits.

sub_mechanisms.name: exponential_objects
sub_mechanisms.definition: B^A: morphisms A → B as object. Currying: Hom(A×B, C) ≅ Hom(A, C^B).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Function types in category. Cartesian closed categories.

sub_mechanisms.name: monoidal_category
sub_mechanisms.definition: Category with tensor product ⊗ + unit + coherence axioms.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Vector spaces (⊗), sets (×), Hilbert spaces. Quantum computing, knot theory.

sub_mechanisms.name: topos_theory
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cartesian closed + subobject classifier. Generalises Set.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation alternative foundations. Set-like categories. Sheaves over topological spaces.

sub_mechanisms.name: sheaves
sub_mechanisms.definition: Presheaves satisfying gluing axiom. Local data uniquely determines global.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern math. Algebraic geometry, manifolds, logic. Grothendieck.

sub_mechanisms.name: System_F_polymorphism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Second-order λ-calculus. ∀α.τ universally quantified types. Generics.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation polymorphic programming. Reynolds + Girard. Standard ML type system. Modern Java generics descendant.

sub_mechanisms.name: Pi_Sigma_types
sub_mechanisms.definition: Dependent products Π(x:A).B(x): functions whose output type depends on input. Sigma dual.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation dependent type theory. Coq, Lean, Agda. Universal quantifier + existential.

sub_mechanisms.name: Coq_Lean_Agda
sub_mechanisms.definition: Proof assistants based on dependent type theory. Verify proofs mechanically.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation modern verified math. Four-color theorem, Feit-Thompson, Kepler conjecture. Lean for new work.

sub_mechanisms.name: univalence_axiom
sub_mechanisms.definition: HoTT: equivalent types are equal. (A ≃ B) ≃ (A = B).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation HoTT. Allows treating isomorphic structures as equal. Voevodsky.

sub_mechanisms.name: higher_inductive_types
sub_mechanisms.definition: Inductive types with both points + paths. Define spheres, quotients directly.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation HoTT. Synthetic homotopy theory. Modern.

sub_mechanisms.name: Curry_Howard_Lambek
sub_mechanisms.definition: Logic ↔ types ↔ categories. Cartesian closed = STLC = intuitionistic logic.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of unification. Programs = proofs = morphisms. Modern theoretical CS.

derivation_rules.name: limits_universal_construction
derivation_rules.why: Universal property defines uniquely up to iso. Foundation of categorical reasoning. Avoids ad hoc constructions.

derivation_rules.name: currying_isomorphism_universal
derivation_rules.why: Hom(A×B, C) ≅ Hom(A, C^B). Universal. Foundation of functional programming. Haskell ubiquitous.

derivation_rules.name: proof_assistants_verify_mathematics
derivation_rules.why: Mechanical verification. Foundation of modern verified math. Lean mathlib growing library.

derivation_rules.name: univalence_collapses_iso_equality
derivation_rules.why: Univalence axiom. Foundation HoTT. Modern foundation candidate. Voevodsky's univalent foundations.

derivation_rules.name: Curry_Howard_Lambek_universal_correspondence
derivation_rules.why: Foundation theoretical CS. Programs = proofs = morphisms. Universal triangle.
